note: Representative model-visible error shapes for the pinned `grep` tool at commit 08819b279cf02ae2545e69dad7111ab48d91d35e. `template` is verbatim from the cited upstream source; `example` renders the template with representative values.

entries.template: Skip must be a non-negative number
entries.example: Skip must be a non-negative number

entries.template: Line-range selector requires a single file, not a glob: ${entry}
entries.example: Line-range selector requires a single file, not a glob: src/*.ts:50-100

entries.template: Path not found for line-range selector: ${original}
entries.example: Path not found for line-range selector: src/gone.rs:50-100

entries.template: Line-range selector requires a single file: ${original} is a directory
entries.example: Line-range selector requires a single file: src is a directory

entries.template: Cannot search archive member(s): ${members}. Read the member with `read <archive>:<member>` and inspect the returned text, or pass a UTF-8 text member.
entries.example: Cannot search archive member(s): data.bin. Read the member with `read app.zip:data.bin` and inspect the returned text, or pass a UTF-8 text member.

entries.template: Path not found: ${missingPaths}; list each target in the semicolon-delimited `path`${archiveHint}
entries.example: Path not found: a.ts, b.rs; list each target in the semicolon-delimited `path`
